name: print-social-red-facebook-cover-with-striped-chart-and-lines
title: Red Striped Chart Facebook Cover
whatItIs: A Facebook profile mockup on a dark red vignette with a cover of red vertical stripes and two crossing white and orange lines, the headline 'Your crypto, made simpler', and the brand avatar and buttons below.
whatItMeans: Turning the product's chart texture into a banner makes the brand instantly recognisable in the feed.
techniques: Striped bars and line graphs as the banner art
Large light headline with a small eyebrow
Circular dark avatar with the white and red mark
One colour world across cover and surroundings

vocabulary.definition: The wide banner image at the top of a profile.
A pattern derived from the product that becomes a signature graphic.
The interface of the social site around the design.
